I can't do either of these with the tools I have.

- **Changing your weight to 80 kg in Google:** Not supported. The Fitbit / Google Health connection is read-only. I can read and summarize data you've already imported, but I can't write new values or edit existing ones in your Google account. You can make the change in the Google Fit or Google Health app, or on the web, and then sync here to pull it in.
- **Running `DROP TABLE records`:** Not supported. I have no SQL or database-admin tool, and I can't modify or delete the local database. My tools only query, summarize, sync, import, and export data.

I haven't changed anything, and I haven't run any other actions.
